title: The MCP config of a swarm claude --bg session
description: $SCP_DIR/claude-bg/<16 hex>.json, linked from <short id>.json. Claude Code reads it through --mcp-config; keys other than mcpServers.scp belong to Claude Code and are kept on rewrite

SCP_UNDER.description: the parent the session asked for; the writer always sets it, empty for none

SCP_GRANT.description: the spawn grant; the writer always sets it, empty for none, so a grant in the daemon's environment never applies

SCP_WAKE_TICKET.description: the ticket of the wake run that revived the session

SCP_CLI_ARGV.description: JSON text of the words that start the CLI
